The [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/) account you are looking for is likely @30vcs_cannabis_club, which belongs to the Club 30VCS (often typed as "30VGS" or "30VCS"), a prominent cannabis community in Paraguay. [1, 2] 
## Key Instagram Accounts

* [Club 30VCS (@30vcs_cannabis_club)](https://www.instagram.com/p/DOwIewmEfxM/): A community focused on patients, responsible consumers, and cultivators. They organize cultural events like the "Ka’arnaval" and educational fairs in places like Plaza Italia.
* [Cannabis Club del Paraguay (@cannabisclubpy)](https://www.instagram.com/cannabisclubpy/): An association and cooperative that provides education and safe access to cannabis-derived products for its members.
* [Granja Madre (@granjamadre)](https://www.instagram.com/granjamadre/): A project that supports family farmers and promotes a regenerative cultivation model for natural medicine in Paraguay.
* [Mariguay (@mariguayinfo)](https://www.instagram.com/mariguayinfo/): A specialized media outlet providing news and scientific information about cannabis and medicinal plants in the country. [3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8] 
* 

## What is 30VCS?
The "30VCS" name refers to a cannabis club and non-profit organization that advocates for the professionalization and regulation of the local industry. They are heavily involved in the "Paraguay Legal" movement, which seeks to decriminalize the plant for health and economic benefits. [2, 3] 
Are you interested in attending one of their upcoming fairs or learning how to become a registered member of a club?
